source.text: ወነጸርኩ፡ ወተመየጥኩ፡ ኀበ፡ ገጸ፡ ምድር፡ ወርእኩ፡ በህየ፡ ቄላ፡ ዐሙቃ፡ እንዘ፡ ትነድድ፡ እሳት።

translation.text: I looked and turned toward the surface of the earth, and there I saw a deep valley with a fire burning.[a]
